_description: Lending policy rules loaded by loan_portal.py and injected into the workflow conversation. No database needed — edit this file to change policy rules.

Conventional.notes: Standard conforming loan. PMI required if LTV > 80%.

FHA.notes: FHA-insured loan. Lower credit threshold but requires mortgage insurance premium.

VA.notes: VA loan for eligible veterans. No down payment required. No PMI.

Jumbo.notes: Loan above conforming limit. Stricter requirements. Strong credit required.

Personal.notes: Unsecured personal loan. No property collateral. Higher rate.

general_rules.income_check_note: If self-reported income differs from verified income by more than 10%, flag as INCONSISTENT.
